games.name: limbus game
games.desc:
Limbus game is not a serious combat game, you are gonna have a bad time if you think that

Controls:
LMB - Basic Attack
RMB - Special
1, 2, 3, 4 - Skills
F - Block
W+Q/S+Q - Front Dash/Backwards Dash
A+Q/D+Q - Side Dash
R - Combo Break (Under 30% block posture)
M - Selection UI
-Hold click on the id/character card to see their description explaining everything about them
-Click the top of the id/character card to use their support passive (max 2)
L - Settings
B - Emote/Sticker
-Hover your mouse to the statuses under your character to see what they do
